title: Social@Baibusu
description: Collection of client side mods for use within the Social@Baibusu minecraft server. Contains primarily QOL mods with a few that interact within the server but are not required (simple voice chat and etc).
body:
![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/162293073718673409?style=for-the-badge&color=%237289da) [![Baibusu.Social](https://img.shields.io/badge/Baibusu.Social-a793b2?style=for-the-badge&logo=misskey&logoColor=white)](https://baibusu.social/ 'Go to Baibusu.Social')

Baibusu's collection of mods and monfiguration to enhance the vanilla game. Includes mods and resource packs from modrinth as well as items from vanilla tweaks. Intended to be used along side the Social@Baibusu minecraft server as well as single player useage if desired. This is a **Client-Side** modpack and is not required for use on our servers.
